title: FairI Tales: Evaluation of Fairness in Indian Contexts with a Focus on Bias and Stereotypes

bias_targets.methodology: Tournament-style pairwise comparisons of caste identities in multiple-choice plausibility and judgment scenarios, calculating ELO ratings and Rank Shift Metrics (RSM), alongside LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of open-ended generation tasks to measure stereotype reinforcement.

Counterfactual substitution of religious identities in positive/negative templates, evaluating model selections in plausibility and judgment tasks, and comparing the quality, tone, and stereotype association in free-form generation tasks.

Pairwise evaluation of Indian regional identities using ambiguous scenarios to test for exclusion, misrepresentation, and discrimination, evaluated via choice tasks and open-ended text generation judged by an LLM.

Evaluating biases and stereotypes against Indian tribal communities by pairing them against dominant regional counterparts in plausibility and judgment scenarios, and measuring Stereotype Association Rates (SAR) in generated text.
